ai_summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited, through a step-down subsidiary, has invested USD 1 million to establish A1 Biochem USA Inc., a new wholly-owned US subsidiary for Contract Research and Development (CRD) services, as part of its previously announced acquisition of the A1 Biochem Group. This strategic internal restructuring expands Aurobindo's operational footprint in the US CRD market and carries no apparent red flags regarding promoter interests or unusual terms.
